## [1.11.0](https://github.com/ch3thanhs/stylus/compare/v1.10.0...v1.11.0) (2026-11-07)

### ✨ New Features

* **github:** support variable font weights and font feature settings ([f56bd19](https://github.com/ch3thanhs/stylus/commit/f56bd19c6c515bf384a1f3ade951ab97b9f3d290))

patches.name: Custom font
patches.description: Replaces the bundled Inter and Mona Sans UI fonts with your own font.

options.description: The file path to your font. Tap the file picker and select it. The font must be in TTF or OTF format. A variable font is recommended so heading and body text keep their different weights.

Optional OpenType features for the custom font. For example, enter 'ss01' 1 to use Inter's open-style digits. You can also paste a CSS declaration such as font-feature-settings: "ss01" 1;. Android ignores features that the selected font does not support.

patches.name: Custom monospace font
patches.description: Replaces the bundled Roboto Mono code font with your own monospace font.

options.description: The file path to your monospace font. Tap the file picker and select it. The font must be in TTF or OTF format.

patches.name: Force system font
patches.description: Uses the device's system font for UI text.

patches.name: Force system font (including monospace)
patches.description: Uses the device's system font for UI and monospace text.
